correctness.rationale: The hyperbolic metric is dR²+sinh²(R)dθ². Inverse D_{1/a} has radial stretch 1/a and tangential sinh(R/a)/sinhR≤1/a for a≥1, giving hyperbolic expansion of D_a and product-separation preservation. For 0<a<1, pairs at radii R_n→∞ with angular sin(θ_n/2)=c/sinh R_n have constant source separation, while target separation tends to 0 as sinh(aR_n)/sinh R_n→0; using the source two-point packet lemma gives an interpolating source sequence and noninterpolating image. Inverse D_{1/a} yields bidirectional iff a=1. Analytic proof all a>0; no finite experiment. Full source theorem/lemma and numerical same-map worked example separately inspected.
